# Proctor House Rottweilers

> Premium marketing/conversion site for an Arizona Rottweiler breeder ("Designer Gorilla" bloodline) — converts an existing social audience into waitlist applications and deposits.

## Project Overview

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router) · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS v4 · next/font (Cinzel/Anton/Inter)
**Status:** Phase 1 of 5 complete (static foundation, local-only); Payload CMS/Postgres/R2/Stripe in later phases
**Purpose:** Paid client project; client is non-technical and will self-manage content via CMS in Phase 2

## Core Documentation

- `README.md` — Setup and getting started (create-next-app default)
- `proctor-house-rottweilers-website-spec.md` — Client-approved spec; source of truth for scope/phases

- `FEATURE_BOUNDARIES.md` — Component responsibilities
- `IMPORT_GRAPH_SUMMARY.md` — Dependency hot spots

## Key Files by Area

### Data (the CMS seam — most load-bearing module)
- `src/lib/placeholder-data.ts` — Dog/Litter types, records, brand constants; Phase 2 swaps records for Payload queries, types stay

### Design system
- `src/app/globals.css` — Tailwind v4 @theme tokens, gold-metallic gradient, font-plate/font-impact utilities
- `src/app/layout.tsx` — fonts, metadata, chrome composition

### Pages
- `src/app/page.tsx` — Home (hero → plates → litters → social → #waitlist)
- `src/app/the-bloodline/page.tsx` — brand centerpiece
- `src/app/dogs/[slug]/page.tsx` — dog detail (static params from data module)
- `src/app/about/page.tsx` — story + disabled contact form mockup

### Components
- `src/components/BloodlinePlate.tsx` — signature gold-framed dog card
- `src/components/{Nav,Footer,WaitlistCta,Hero,Reveal,SocialEmbed}.tsx`

## Common Tasks

**To run locally:** `npm run dev` (port 3000; `.claude/launch.json` has the preview config)
**To add/edit a dog:** edit `dogs` in `src/lib/placeholder-data.ts`; detail page and plates update everywhere
**To verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build`
**Before touching Next.js APIs:** read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` — this Next version has breaking changes vs. training data (see AGENTS.md)

## Environment Variables

- None in Phase 1. Later: Payload secret, DATABASE_URL (Neon), R2 keys, Stripe keys (client-owned; never handled by the developer — ADR-003)

## Hard Constraints

- Stock dog photos in `public/dogs/` are demo-only; replacing with the client's real dogs is a launch blocker (ADR-004)
- Mobile is the primary experience; the persistent waitlist CTA must survive all changes
